dz: 由可汗·托克塔米什所领导的"金色霍尔德"开始"莫斯科之围",四天后随着城市被攻入并被穆斯科维特王子奥斯泰所杀而结束.
de: The Golden Horde, led by Khan Tokhtamysh, begins the Siege of Moscow, which ends four days later with the storming of the city and the death of Muscovite Prince Ostei.

t: 路易大帝的女儿玛丽被加冕为匈牙利“国王”。
te: Louis the Great's daughter, Mary, is crowned "king" of Hungary.
dz: 路易大帝的女儿玛丽被加冕为匈牙利“国王”。
de: Louis the Great's daughter, Mary, is crowned "king" of Hungary.

t: 萨利赫·哈吉(Al-Salih Hajji)是最后一个卡拉武尼德苏丹被巴克克废黜,结束了长期突…
te: Al-Salih Hajji, the last Qalawunid sultan, is deposed by Barquq, ending the long Turkic Bahri Mamluk period in general …
dz: 萨利赫·哈吉(Al-Salih Hajji)是最后一个卡拉武尼德苏丹被巴克克废黜,结束了长期突厥克·巴赫里·马姆卢克时期的通称,尤其是卡拉武尼德王朝,开始了切尔克西人布尔吉·马姆卢克的统治.
de: Al-Salih Hajji, the last Qalawunid sultan, is deposed by Barquq, ending the long Turkic Bahri Mamluk period in general and particularly the Qalawunid dynasty, and beginning the reign of the Circassian Burji Mamluk.
